title: Blue Book contractor websites
description: Add Blue Book search, category, or contractor-profile URLs; collect public company websites and contacts; and prevent duplicates across runs.

startUrls.title: Blue Book search or profile URLs
startUrls.description: Paste TheBlueBook.com search/category URLs or direct iProView contractor profile URLs.

maximumNewCompanies.title: Maximum new companies this run
maximumNewCompanies.description: Stop after this many unique contractor websites are collected.

maximumProfilesVisited.title: Maximum profiles visited this run
maximumProfilesVisited.description: Maximum contractor profiles opened in one run, including profiles without websites.

maximumListingPagesThisRun.title: Maximum listing pages this run
maximumListingPagesThisRun.description: Maximum Blue Book search-result pages processed during one run.

requireWebsite.title: Require external company website
requireWebsite.description: Output only contractor profiles containing a website outside The Blue Book.

collectEmails.title: Collect public profile emails
collectEmails.description: Collect email addresses publicly displayed in the Blue Book profile.

visitCompanyWebsitesForEmails.title: Visit company websites for emails
visitCompanyWebsitesForEmails.description: Open collected company homepages and collect public emails. This increases time and proxy usage.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxy
useResidentialProxy.description: Recommended because The Blue Book returned HTTP 403 from normal data-center connections during testing.

proxyCountryCode.title: Proxy country code
proxyCountryCode.description: Two-letter residential-proxy country code. Use US for The Blue Book.

campaignName.title: Campaign name
campaignName.description: Keep unchanged on continuation runs to preserve queues and duplicate protection.

resetProgress.title: Reset saved progress
resetProgress.description: Erase this campaign's saved queues and duplicate history before the run.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page navigation timeout
pageTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds for one listing, profile, or company website.

delayMillis.title: Delay between pages
delayMillis.description: Waiting time in milliseconds after each page navigation.
